# Meteroid API

Every operation of the API, as a method of a `*meteroid.Client` (`client` below), by
resource. Each method also takes trailing `...RequestOption`s, such as `WithMaxRetries`,
`WithTimeout`, `WithHeader` or `WithResponseInto`, for that call. Models and option structs are
in the `meteroid` package.
